name: Sort my inbox
tagline: Triage today's email: flag urgent, draft replies for the rest
description: Your AI team scans your inbox, flags the messages that need your eyes, and drafts polite replies to the rest. Drafts wait in Gmail for your approval before they send.
starterPrompt: Look at the emails in my inbox from the last 24 hours. For each one: tell me which ones are urgent and need my eyes, then draft a polite reply to each non-urgent one and leave the draft in Gmail for me to approve.
defaultGoal: Stay on top of email without the dread.
